scope: EP0-7 same saved scheduler digest, 8 selected index-source layers; one profile, not identical requests or work
limits: Physical signature and scheduler digest are not dynamic workload, values, storage, binary, request identity or no-disturbance evidence.
All durations from trace event intervals under one intrusive profiler; not independent online samples or steady-state latency.
One matched task per name is limited by extraction coverage; no-match or exclusions do not mean absence of execution.
Same track and sequence do not prove tensor edges or wait causality; durations are not additive end-to-end or achievable speedup.
